Initial Setup & Permissions To function effectively, AmnShield requires a few core Android permissions. Display Over Other Apps: Required to show the block screen or Smart Blur overlay when an infraction occurs. 2. Core Features App Blocker & Schedules Navigate to the Blocks dashboard to manage your app restrictions. You can create grouped schedules (e.g., blocking all social media from 9 AM to 5 PM) or apply Launch Limits to restrict how many times you can open an app per day. Focus Mode Focus Mode is designed for deep work. When activate

ny times you can open an app per day. Focus Mode Focus Mode is designed for deep work. When activated, it locks down all distracting apps for a set duration. Advanced AI features like Smart Blur may require a premium subscription to support ongoing development. Does my data leave my device? No. All keyword filtering, app usage monitoring, and AI moderation happens 100% locally on your device. We do not have servers that collect your usage history, keywords, or images. AmnShield uses Android's Accessibility API to read the text currently on your screen (to check for blocked keywords) and to detect which app you are using so it can enforce your block schedules and Focus Mode. We do not use this permission to collect or transmit any data. Features & Configuration How does the Smart Blur AI work? What are "Cheat Hours"? Cheat Hours allow you to set specific, limited time windows where certain blocked apps are temporarily allowed.
